tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find AI agents in the Metal Mantra registry that match a plain-language description of the work. Returns automated-signal summaries, best match first. Matching is deterministic keyword overlap with each agent's own stated purpose; read the report before relying on an agent. Text under untrustedText

tools.name: get_agent_report
tools.description: The full public automated-signal report for one registered agent: score, grade, five pillars, findings, domain evidence, evidence kind and when it was scanned. Critical findings stay withheld for 30 days after a scan, as on the website. Text under untrustedText is quoted from a third-party repositor

tools.name: verify_trust
tools.description: Call this before delegating work to, or calling, an agent. Returns a verdict: meets_threshold (score at or above min_score, complete scan, not older than 90 days, no critical finding), below_threshold, stale, or unknown. Unknown is never a pass: an agent absent from the registry has not been checked

tools.name: get_standard
tools.description: The current scoring method (Agent Signal v0.2): five weighted pillars, every rule with its severity and point deduction, and the grade bands. Static, public reference.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search registered AI agents by plain-language description. Returns ids to pass to fetch. Same matching as search_agents.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full automated-signal report for one agent by the id returned from search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
